items.title: Al Tinney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: I came all this way, 81 years, to find you, Monk Rowe, to tell this story to.

ctx.x: Yeah. I would take the compliment though.

Yeah well I kind of take it like that. Especially with the big hug and stuff. She was a wonderful woman. But anyhow that’s another thing that kind of bothered me or that stuck with me through the years I’d say. And I came all this way, 81 years, to find you, Monk Rowe, to tell this story to. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

And I appreciate hearing it. You know we like to think, those of us who weren’t there again, we think that everybody got along all the time, that musicians liked each other and all those things, and musicians are just human beings too, right?
